name: Beltelecom Data Centre (TsOD RUE Beltelecom)
notes: State operator commercial hosting/colocation offer; sales/contact address 220030 Minsk, Engelsa 6; Beltelecom has operated a network of TsODs since 2006; 24/7/365 facility with DDoS-protection add-on. Regional TsOD addresses not verified.

name: Beltelecom TsOD, Zakharova 55 (International Communications Centre)
notes: First Beltelecom TsOD opened June 2006 at the International Communications Centre, Minsk, ul. Zakharova 55; first hosting platform in Belarus per official operator page; current facility status documented by operator.

name: A1 Digital data centre
developer: A1 Belarus / A1 ICT services (velcom legacy)
notes: Operator markets the largest Tier III-class data centre in Belarus (built 2017); Uptime Institute Tier III Design & Facility certificates and PCI DSS per Wikipedia; exact physical address not public on operator pages (directory cites ul. Tankovaya 11 - C-grade address only).

name: MTS Cloud own data centre (MTS Belarus)
notes: Own protected Minsk data centre, ~370 sqm, 78 server racks, launched 3 Mar 2021 at MTS HQ in Minsk; MTS Cloud homepage additionally lists 46 racks at RCOD (beCloud, Tier III) as a tenant footprint - do not double-count as a separate facility. Exact site address not public (directory pr. Nezavisimosti 95 is C-grade).

name: NTSEU state cloud / StoreCloud e-government platform
developer: RUE National Centre for Electronic Services (NTSEU)
notes: State e-government/cloud storage platform (ownCloud-based StoreCloud); legal address 220140 Minsk, Prititskogo 64; verified state platform, not public commercial colocation.

name: Datahata data centre
notes: Commercial colocation/hosting operator claiming first commercial DC in Belarus (14+ years); own DC 100 sqm, 5 kW/rack, N+1 UPS + 20h diesel; located Minsk, ul. Sharangovicha 19 (NPO Center territory) per operator site.

name: beCloud Republican Data Processing Centre (RCOD)
notes: Flagship state-cloud facility at Minsk district, ag. Kolodishchi, ul. Tsentralnaya 22; cornerstone laid 7 May 2015 (TVnews); hosts the national cloud/republican platform; Tier III/Uptime-related claims per trade - certification currency needs direct verification.
